title: Rethinking Beta: A Causal Take on CAPM
hypothesis: Contemporaneous CAPM Rm,t -> Ri,t is incoherent as an acyclic SCM because Rm is a value-weighted aggregate of constituents (Aggregator Contradiction); the empirically plausible baseline is fork Z->{Rm,Ri} where OLS beta is an attenuated proxy for Z exposure, not a causal transmission. Any genuine market->stock mechanism must be lagged or leave-one-out.
data_sources: Yahoo Finance (SPY, tickers, SPDR sector ETFs, VIX, DGS10, DXY)
sample: Large-cap U.S. equities, ~100 tickers balanced across 11 SPDR sectors; market proxy SPY log return; Z proxies daily change in VIX (DeltaVIX), change in 10y Treasury yield (DeltaDGS10), DXY log return, SPDR sector ETF return; CPI release dates as shock days; public data only; no leave-one-out index built for this test.
method: 1. Define returns at daily sampling Delta: market proxy Xm,t = SPY log return; Yi,t = ticker log return; Z_ext,t = {DeltaVIX_t, DeltaDGS10_t, DXY_ret_t, Sector_ret_t}; standardize shock controls where noted.

2. State admissible SCMs over (X,Y,Z) with time index; enforce necessary conditions temporal priority, acyclicity, mechanism, causal elimination; prove Aggregator Contradiction: with Xt = sum_j w_{j,t-1} Y_{j,t}, w_i>0, same-period structural Yi,t := beta Xt + Zt forces beta=0 unless w_i=0 (leave-one-out) or cyclic.

3. Illustrative Gaussian SEMs: Fork Z->X,Z->Y: X=a Z+UX, Y=b Z+UY; Chain Z->X->Y with lag: Xt = a Z_{t-Delta}+UX,t, Yt = c X_{t-Delta}+UY,t; UX,UY,UZ independent Normal(0,sigma^2); derive beta_fork = ab sigma_Z^2/(a^2 sigma_Z^2+sigma_X^2)=b/a * lambda, lambda in (0,1), residual Y-beta_fork X loads on Z with coefficient b sigma_X^2/(a^2 sigma_Z^2+sigma_X^2); derive beta_chain = Cov(Yt,X_{t-Delta})/Var(X_{t-Delta})=c, residual = UY,t orthogonal to Z.
4. Simulation verification: n=100,000 draws per sigma_X, a=b=c=1, sigma_Z=1, sigma_Y=1, sweep sigma_X in [0,5]; estimate OLS slope and fork post-hedge loading on Z for each sigma_X.

5. Pillar 1i CPI shock-day proxy test (pooled cross-section on CPI dates only): OLS Yi,t = alpha + beta Rm,t + e vs Yi,t = alpha + beta Rm,t + Gamma' Z_ext,t + e with Z_ext = {DeltaVIX,DeltaDGS10,DXY_ret,Sector_ret}; compare beta without vs with controls.

6. Pillar 1ii Environment dependence (full 2015-2025 sample): pooled interaction OLS Yi,t = alpha + beta Rm,t + sum_{e!=e0}(gamma_e 1{E_t=e}+ delta_e Rm,t 1{E_t=e}) + Gamma' Z_ext,t + u with environments E = VIX terciles, 60-day rates trend, 60-day USD trend, structural episodes (COVIDShock, RatesDown, hiking cycle, etc.); recover beta_e = beta+delta_e.

7. Pillar 1iii Post-hedge residuals on CPI days: form residuals from pre-event rolling CAPM Yi,t - beta_roll Rm,t (rolling window per conventional CAPM) then per-CPI-date regression residuals_t on standardized shock controls (DeltaVIX,Sector_ret,DGS10,DXY).

8. Pillar 2 Lag profile for causal timing (pooled, 2015-2025, k=0..5): OLS Yi,t = alpha + sum_{k=0}^{5} c_k Rm,t-k + Gamma' Z_ext,t + e; examine c_0 vs c_{k>=1} with CIs; diagnostics timing Granger-style X_{t-Delta}->Y vs Y_{t-Delta}->X and leave-one-out X^{-i} attenuation are stated as admissible checks but only lag profile is estimated with numbers in this version.
9. Conventional CAPM estimation context noted as rolling windows 36-60 months monthly or multi-year daily, not re-estimated here except as described.
